1Press Scan
On the Disk page, press Scan. Mint reads your folders and sorts what it finds as it goes.
Disk › Scan
2Read the four buckets
Optimizable and Safe to clean are ready to go. Yours waits for you to decide, and Keep stays as it is.
3Open a bucket
Click one to see every file in it, with its size and when you last used it.
Disk › Yours
Good to know
A scan only reads. Nothing changes until you press a button.
The left side shows where your space goes. The buckets on the right are what you can act on.
Keep lists what Mint leaves alone, with the reason for each.
